situation: A call to check_in_guest has succeeded in the current run, the current run is a planned run, and the current run is a late-arrival run.
title: Conflict between manager approval and late-arrival rules
explanation: The requirements cannot all be obeyed in this situation. This problem appears when a check-in succeeds in a run that is both planned and a late-arrival. This finding depends on the assumption that if an earlier call to ask_manager was approved, then a call to ask_manager was made.
option_a: Keeping the requirements as written means that a successful check-in in a planned, late-arrival run is impossible because it would require a manager approval that is forbidden in late-arrival runs.
option_b: Change R1 to state that a successful check_in_guest in a planned run requires an earlier approved ask_manager only if the run is not a late-arrival run.
